caption: The drawing shows a silhouette of a stag with antlers, depicted in profile facing to the right. The figure is rendered in shades of gray, with a stippled texture giving it a mottled appearance. The stag has a short tail, pronounced chest, and four legs, with the hind legs bent and the front legs extended straight. The body of the stag is mounted on a horizontal rectangular bar, which has a vertical support extending downward from beneath the front leg area. There is a scale in inches in the bottom left corner and the artist’s name, Rollington Campbell, is visible in the bottom right corner. The drawing is outlined by a single rectangular border, with a plain cream or beige background.
title: Weather Vane
